finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the IP address is attacker-controlled and the program later executes a command with this IP address as part of a shell command, it could lead to OS command injection.
finding.assumptions: The IP address is attacker-controlled and the program later uses this IP address in a shell command.
